**P2 — Drain the timeout execution before reusing its capacity**

`expected=None` returns even when the durable execution is still `RUNNING`. Because timeout victims use asynchronous invocation and may be reinvoked, a retry can occupy one runtime slot while `overlap_case` immediately demands every configured slot and while later cases reuse the same function. This can make correct behavior fail placement or warm-state assertions. Stop or wait for the victim to become terminal and drain retry requests before the full-capacity check, including cleanup on exceptional paths.
